deploy.startCommand: sh -lc 'if [ "$DISABLE_RUNTIME" = "1" ]; then node -e "const http=require(\"http\");const p=Number(process.env.PORT||3000);const s=http.createServer((q,r)=>{r.statusCode=200;r.end(\"disabled\");});s.listen(p,()=>setTimeout(()=>s.close(()=>process.exit(0)),60000));"; else exec node server.js; fi'
